events.text: The Savings Account Service Domain in BIAN v14.0.0 is responsible for managing and exposing the live operational representation of a savings account instance. It is a runtime, instance-level domain — not a contract or directory domain.

items: Entitlement option settings — account-level parameter overrides

events.text: 2.2 What This SD Does NOT Manage
The Control Record for this SD is SavingsAccountFacility. Key structural enhancements (array normalisation) have been applied to the standard BIAN v14 definition:

rows: Links to the product agreement (SavingAccountAgreement / CustomerAgreement)
The account holder; maps to stakeholder_ids in core
Base and secondary currencies; multiple permitted denominations
Product-level parameters — defined at product version level
Restriction templates applicable to this account
Active restriction instances on the account

events.text: No new Behaviour Qualifiers were introduced in this implementation. All enhancements remain inside the existing Savings Account SD structure, ensuring full BIAN alignment with no domain boundary violation.
The three standard CR-level operations are implemented:

rows: Creates the Control Record for the account instance. Account status starts as PENDING. No parameters are set at this stage.
Applies parameters, updates account status (PENDING to OPEN), and reflects ongoing lifecycle changes (balance, status, restriction, currency changes).
Returns the full operational state of the account including balances, parameters, dates, and restrictions.

events.text: The SD manages the following account lifecycle state transitions:

rows: POST /SavingsAccount/Initiate — CR created, core account provisioned
Balance changes, restriction changes, parameter overrides — re-invoke Update
Funds available for immediate use by the account holder
Pending credits not yet settled — funds expected to arrive
Pending debits not yet settled — funds expected to leave
The date the account was formally opened — only populated when account status is OPEN
The date the account became active / was activated — always populated
The date the account record was created in the system — always populated
The primary operating currency of the account — one per account
Additional permitted denominations — zero or more per account

events.text: When a customer logs into mobile banking, the application calls Retrieve to display balances, currency, status, account details, and parameters. This is a read-only call to the SD.
When a user requests their current balance, the SD Retrieve operation returns the AccountBalances[] array, which contains AvailableBalance, ExpectedIncomingBalance, and ExpectedOutgoingBalance.
When the UI needs to display product rules (e.g. minimum withdrawal limits), the EntitlementOptionDefinition[] array from the Retrieve response contains these product-level parameter definitions.
The Update operation must be re-invoked whenever any of the following occur:

items: The bank operator can freeze or unfreeze an account, restricting all transactions to and from it.
This operation triggers when the update API is called and the fields for restriction templates and instances are populated.
Only the bank operator can initiate this operation; customers cannot request a freeze or unfreeze.
Only transactions are restricted on frozen accounts; customers can still access their accounts and view documents.
No notification is sent to customers when their accounts are frozen or unfrozen.

events.text: 8. BIAN Structural Enhancements — Proposed Changes to Standard
The following enhancements to the BIAN v14 standard are recommended based on implementation experience:

rows: AccountCurrency, AccountBalance, AccountDate, EntitlementOptionDefinition/Setting, RestrictionOptionDefinition/Setting should all be defined as arrays. Real implementations always contain multiple values.
BIAN should prescribe standard enums: AvailableBalance, ExpectedIncomingBalance, ExpectedOutgoingBalance — to prevent institution-specific naming.
Changed from object to string to resolve circular referencing in the YAML schema definition.
All enhancements retained inside existing SD structure. No domain boundary violation. Full BIAN alignment maintained.
